page1.text: I scrounge up every bit of strength and grit, and...

page2.text: "I'll follow your plan. We're only taking off the shroud, right?"

page3.text: I manage to make myself nod.

page4.text:
"...Yeah. You'll do it, huh?"
"What, Tohsaka? You don't like my answer?"

page5.text:
"I didn't say that. I just remembered that it's pointless to try and intimidate you.
I didn't expect you to say that you'd be okay with taking off the shroud. But I'm satisfied with your answer."
Tohsaka huffs and turns away, clearly unhappy.

page6.text: "Mrgh. You're being weird. I was trying to show you that I'm determined to help, but you make it sound like I did something wrong."

page7.text:
"Yeah. I am being weird.
It's the answer I wanted to hear, but it still pisses me off to hear it."

page8.text:
"And Shirou, I said earlier that I'd never make you use Archer's arm. Meaning that I wouldn't make you take off the shroud.
I know how this sounds right after I was trying to test you, but never say that you're going to take off the shroud again.
...Once you do, there's no going back."
